episodes.title: Til Death Do Us Part
episodes.summary: Joker abandons Harley Quinn--again--and Poison Ivy tries to convince Harley that Joker is no good for her.

episodes.title: A High Bar
episodes.summary: Harley crashes Penguin's nephew's bar mitzvah in an attempt to impress the Legion of Doom. Kite Man hits on Ivy, and Joker can't resist demeaning Bane.

episodes.title: So You Need a Crew?
episodes.summary: After Joker "steals" one of her heists, Harley figures that she needs to put together a crew of her own. However, no man wants to work for a female super-villain.

episodes.title: Finding Mr. Right
episodes.summary: When Harley tries to get her first nemesis, she ends up with Robin and isn't happy. Batman comes to his ward's rescue, and Joker comes looking for the nemesis that he thinks Harley stole from him.

episodes.title: Being Harley Quinn
episodes.summary: Harley is forced to make a decision on her own and suffers level-four brain freeze. To save her, Dr. Psycho takes the crew into Harley's mind to reboot it. Meanwhile Sy teams up with his old spy partner to dispose of the comatose crew members.

episodes.title: You're a Damn Good Cop, Jim Gordon
episodes.summary: Commissioner Gordon loses a friend in Batman, but gains a new one when he interrogates Clayface's severed arm. Meanwhile, Harley and Clayface try to steal the arm back, and Psycho and Ivy visits the Cowled Critic who dared to criticize Harley's crew.

episodes.title: The Line
episodes.summary: Harley breaks the Queen of Fables out of prison to add some evil oomph to her crew – but maybe Fables is a little TOO evil?

episodes.title: L.O.D.R.S.V.P
episodes.summary: Harley gets an invite to the Legion of Doom's prospective members party, but Ivy discovers that it's her they're really after.

episodes.title: A Seat at the Table
episodes.summary: Now a member of the Legion of Doom and The Joker's equal, Harley finds herself spending time with him. Will she slip into her old ways?

episodes.title: Bensonhurst
episodes.summary: After a falling out with her crew, Harley heads back home to Bensonhurst, where her doting mother waits for her... and her deadbeat dad, who's more dangerous than anticipated.

episodes.title: Harley Quinn Highway
episodes.summary: Harley must rescue Ivy from the clutches of Scarecrow, who's trying to harvest her pheromones to make a super toxin that turns plants into sentient monsters.

episodes.title: Devil's Snare
episodes.summary: Harley thinks the Legion of Doom is behind Ivy's capture and the tree monsters currently ravaging Gotham. But it's a trap!

episodes.title: The Final Joke
episodes.summary: Harley has her final showdown with the Joker, when [spoilers] [spoil] [spoilers]. Will they [spoiler]? Maybe. But you can bet they [spoiler]!

episodes.title: New Gotham
episodes.summary: After Gotham is declared no longer part of the United States, the newly formed Injustice League try to seize control of the city away from Harley.

episodes.title: Riddle U
episodes.summary: Harley & Ivy go undercover as college students to take down Riddler, who's made himself dean of the local university with sinister plans for students.

episodes.title: Trapped
episodes.summary: Harley & Ivy team up with Catwoman to steal a museum artifact that's been boobytrapped by Dr. Trap. Meanwhile, Dr. Psycho tries to prove himself as a leader.

episodes.title: Thawing Hearts
episodes.summary: Harley and crew try to infiltrate Mr. Freeze's lair only to become human lab rats for his experiments to find a cure for his cryogenically frozen wife, Nora.

episodes.title: Batman's Back Man
episodes.summary: Bruce Wayne awakens from his coma to find Gotham in shambles. Meanwhile, Two-Face attempts to forge a criminal alliance with Bane, to be the only two Big Bads left in Gotham.

episodes.title: All the Best Inmates Have Daddy Issues
episodes.summary: When Harley & Ivy spot a seemingly sane Joker, they debate whether people can change – revisiting a flashback about Harleen Quinzel's first day at Arkham.

episodes.title: There's No Place To Go But Down
episodes.summary: Acting as a judge, Two Face sentences Harley & Ivy to life in Bane's prison. Meanwhile, Jim Gordon and Batgirl vow to take back the GCPD from Two Face.

episodes.title: Inner (Para) Demons
episodes.summary: While Harley & Ivy deal with their post-kiss awkwardness, the President tells Gordon that he must get rid of Harley to put Gotham back on the map.

episodes.title: Bachelorette
episodes.summary: It's Bachelor/Bachelorette weekend for Ivy and Kite Man.

episodes.title: Dye Hard
episodes.summary: Alone on Christmas Eve, Harley reconnects with a now-sane Joker and heads to Wayne Tower, where their dinner is interrupted by an escaped Riddler and ParaDemons.

episodes.title: A Fight Worth Fighting For
episodes.summary: In order to defeat Psycho's army, Harley & Joker need to track down Fables' storybook with the Justice League inside.

episodes.title: Lovers' Quarrel
episodes.summary: Darkseid agrees to give Psycho the world if he brings him the head of Harley Quinn, so Psycho controls Ivy to set her against Harley.

episodes.title: The Runaway Bridesmaid
episodes.summary: Ivy and Kite Man's wedding plans are threatened to be derailed by an overzealous Commissioner Gordon who can't resist a party with all of Gotham's biggest villains; Ivy and Kite Man's best chance at happiness is for Harley to come to the rescue.

episodes.title: Harlivy
episodes.summary: After fleeing the wedding, Harley and Ivy go on an "Eat Bang Kill" tour that leads them to a secret project Ivy abandoned years ago.

episodes.title: There's No Ivy in Team
episodes.summary: After a heist gone wrong, Harley takes the crew to an escape room to foster camaraderie and sharpen Ivy's leadership skills.

episodes.title: The 83rd Annual Villy Awards
episodes.summary: After receiving a "Best Couple" nomination at the 83rd Annual Villy Awards, Ivy finds herself seated next to her ex's new girlfriend while Harley goes overboard to ensure their win.

episodes.title: A Thief, A Mole, An Orgy
episodes.summary: When Frank goes missing, Harley and Ivy follow clues that lead them to a highly unconventional party alongside Gotham's elite, including Commissioner Gordon - who is hungry for campaign donations.

episodes.title: It's a Swamp Thing
episodes.summary: Harley, Ivy, and Nora travel to New Orleans in search of Swamp Thing, who just might be able to help them find Frank.

episodes.title: Joker: The Killing Vote
episodes.summary: When The Joker runs for Mayor of Gotham, Two Face attempts to sabotage his campaign.

episodes.title: Another Sharkley Adventure
episodes.summary: Harley infiltrates a gala on a mission to confront Frank's captor... only to be entangled in another evil plot.

episodes.title: Batman Begins Forever
episodes.summary: After Harley receives access to Bruce Wayne's mind, she gets stuck in an endless loop of his most formative memory.

episodes.title: Climax at Jazzapajizza
episodes.summary: When an inadvertent plant zombie apocalypse breaks out in Gotham, Harley fights to save the city, while Ivy embraces her inner supervillain.

episodes.title: The Horse and The Sparrow
episodes.summary: After her terraforming plan goes awry, Ivy is enticed by an offer to take over the Legion of Doom, while Harley questions her path forward.

episodes.title: Gotham's Hottest Hotties
episodes.summary: Harley and Ivy struggle to find their footing in their new respective roles in the Bat Family and the Legion of Doom.

episodes.title: B.I.T.C.H
episodes.summary: After breaking the Bat Family's #1 rule, a demoted Harley shadows Alfred, while Ivy finds an unexpected mentor at a networking event.

episodes.title: Icons Only
episodes.summary: In Vegas for some much-needed QT, Harley struggles at the Strip's evilest hotel, while a desperate lvy tries to secure tickets to Clayface's show.

episodes.title: The First Person to Come Back from a Business Conference Without Chlamydia
episodes.summary: Lex Luthor keeps Ivy on a short leash at a conference on the moon, while the Bat Family rents out Wayne Manor after Talia slashes company finances.

episodes.title: Getting Ice Dick, Don't Wait Up
episodes.summary: When Batgirl goes missing, Harley goes on an adventure with her roommate, while a spotlight-shy Ivy connects with a PR team after her Malcon success.

episodes.title: Metamorphosis
episodes.summary: Harley investigates the sudden death of a hero, while Ivy tries to take down the Jons; Joker announces a career change.

episodes.title: The Most Culturally Impactful Film Franchise of All Time
episodes.summary: Harley and Ivy use the time sphere and visit the their future and learn of a pending apocolypse.

episodes.title: II Buffone
episodes.summary: While Lex lays siege to the LOD after coming up short with his Ozone Machine, Bane travels to Italy to fix a pasta-maker… and win Nora's affection.

episodes.title: Potato Based Cloning Incident
episodes.summary: Ivy competes in a celebrity golf tournament. Harley learns a dark truth about herself … from herself.

episodes.title: Killer's Block
episodes.summary: Ivy crashes a birthday party on the moon. Harley contemplates how to best avenge her friend.

episodes.title: The Big Apricot
episodes.summary: No longer Gotham's "...Most Exciting-est Couple Ever," Harley and Ivy decide to shake things up at Metropolis' event of the year.

episodes.title: Back to School
episodes.summary: While Ivy's first day of work brings an unwelcome surprise, Harley juggles babysitting, landing a club membership, and her new friendship with Lena.

episodes.title: Floronic Man
episodes.summary: Despite closing the door on her academic trauma, Ivy's past still haunts her. Clayface confronts the Daily Planet's top brass after a bad review.

episodes.title: Breaking Brainiac
episodes.summary: Brainiac has one last task to finish before he can be promoted within the Coluian government -- but unforeseen variables change his life forever.

episodes.title: Big Pasta Dinner
episodes.summary: Old wounds and fears bubble to the surface when Harley and Ivy are invited to a meet and greet for their condo building.

episodes.title: Bottle My Heart
episodes.summary: After Lena divulges Brainiac's plans to the Daily Planet, Harley, Clayface, Bane and Frank try to take him down with an original musical.

episodes.title: Frankette
episodes.summary: The team gains a surprising new addition in the wake of a devastating loss. Meanwhile, as Ivy and Harley set out to bring the murderer to justice, Bane must protect Goldie and the other school kids from citywide destruction.

episodes.title: Family Feud
episodes.summary: With tensions between them at an all-time high, Harley heads to Bensonhurst for a family emergency, while Ivy vows to take down Lena once and for all.

episodes.title: Bottle Episode (But Not a 'Bottle Episode')
episodes.summary: Harley and Ivy attempt to mend the longstanding childhood rivalry between the Luthor siblings before Metropolis is destroyed. Meanwhile, an unlikely alliance forms between Bruce, the Joker and Lois as they fight for their lives amid the chaos in the city.

episodes.title: The Mess is the Point
episodes.summary: Harley, Ivy and Sharon team up with Brainiac to save the universe from Lex and Lena's total domination.
